paite: TOUPA phat un! Pathian a mun siangthou ah phat unla; athilhihtheihna huihkhua zapi ah amah phat un!
heading: TOUPA Phat Un!
english: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

paite: Athilhih thupitak ziak in amah phat unla; athupi mahmah dan bang in amah phat un!
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

paite: Pengkul ging in amah phat unla; pekging leh kaihging in amah phat un!
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

paite: Khuangta leh lam in amah phat unla; kaihging tuamtuam leh tamngai in amah phat un!
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

paite: Dakkhutbet ngaihtak in amah phat unla; dakkhutbet ngaihtak in amah phat un!
english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

paite: Bangkim, hathei peuhmah in TOUPA phat hen! TOUPA phat un!
english: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
